a: 2-year awards; budget and number of awards not stated
dt: Mandatory NOI due Jan 4, 2027; full proposals due Feb 18, 2027 (ROSES-25 Amendment 82). Proposer videoconference Dec 11, 2026, noon ET.
e: New ROSES-25 element funding US data-gathering work in support of ESA's Ariel exoplanet mission: candidate confirmation, mass and orbit determination and host-star characterization (time-series photometry, high-resolution imaging and spectroscopy, precision radial velocities), with results delivered through ExoFOP. Proposals are reviewed dual-anonymously; awards do not confer Ariel consortium membership.
n: NASA ROSES-2025 D.11 U.S. Contributions to Ariel Preparatory Science (Ariel US CAPS)
unv: Total budget, number of awards and any eligibility limits were not stated on the amendment page or the grants.gov synopsis; the full program-element PDF on NSPIRES was not read.
